ideas.idea: Remove the site-wide Disallow in robots.txt (item 1)
ideas.why: This is a known problem, but the report's own framing is accurate. It only matters if not already excluded; listed as the main note.

ideas.idea: Add prerendering or server rendering so content is in server HTML, including the catalogue fetch
ideas.why: It is accurate to the files and it names the Catalogue fetch('/api/mugs') as client-only data, which goes beyond the known empty-root problem.
index.html lacks it, but this applies to almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page/URL with name, price and description
ideas.why:
Catalogue.jsx renders only names in

tags with no per-item routes, so individual products can't be linked or found.

ideas.idea: Add Product JSON-LD once mugs have their own pages
ideas.why: There is no structured data in the repo, and it is correctly conditioned on per-mug pages existing.

ideas.idea: Add shipping costs/times, care instructions and how-to-order text to the home page
ideas.why: Home.jsx has a single sentence about Bristol and worldwide shipping, so this adds concrete missing content.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD with shop name and location
ideas.why: Nothing in the repo states the shop identity in machine-readable form, and Home.jsx mentions Bristol.

ideas.idea: Show prices, sizes and materials in the catalogue text
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx shows only m.name, so adding these attributes gives readers and machines more to work with.

ideas.idea: Add a plain in-body link from the home page to the catalogue
ideas.why: Accurate, but it largely duplicates the known button-versus-link problem, which fixing the nav already covers.
main.jsx has only two Routes and no catch-all, so unknown paths render a blank page.

ideas.idea: Declare an absolute canonical URL (needs the domain)
ideas.why: No canonical exists, but with only two routes and no duplicate URLs it has little effect and needs an unknown domain.

ideas.idea: Per-page titles on the client need prerendering to reach crawlers
ideas.why: It is accurate but is a caveat to other fixes rather than a separate action.
